label: PF Backlog 569
title: FEATURE_PR validation never runs the repo quality gate in the validation worktree -> framework-repo PRs BLOCK with quality_gate unknown
body: Observed: BI-PF-0395 delivery BLOCKED on the single check quality_gate 'no quality-gate record' (3 runs, 2026-10-12; also seen on BI-PF-0394 which had to be merged by hand). Root cause: validation_engine.feature_pr runs the FEATURE_PR checks in a FRESH validation worktree, but _check_quality_gate only READS quality-gate.json; nothing RUNS compileall+wired_audit in that worktree, so the record can never exist there -> status 'unknown' -> BLOCKED (fail-closed) for every framework-repo PR. The quality gate is produced only by pipeline_executor (item/amend runs) and the delivery push-ref fallback - not by the PR validation path. RCCA fix: FEATURE_PR runs the repo gate live in the validated code root and records it (run-scoped for the run id) before the quality_gate check reads it.

objective: Make FEATURE_PR validation self-sufficient: run compileall+wired_audit in the validated code root and record a run-scoped quality-gate record so quality_gate reflects the PR tree (pass/fail), never a spurious 'unknown'/BLOCKED.
acceptance_criteria: feature_pr runs the repo quality gate in the validation worktree and records it (run-scoped + latest)
quality_gate check reads the just-produced record: pass on a clean PR tree, fail (not unknown) on a broken one
regression test: quality_gate is pass after feature_pr on a clean framework branch (no pre-existing record)
in_scope: core/validation_engine.feature_pr (run + record the gate before the check)
out_of_scope: changing the gate's checks (compileall+wired_audit stay as-is)
the RELEASE profile path (already runs the gate)
approach: In feature_pr, after the validated code root (val_dir) is resolved and before the checker loop, call run_quality_gate.evaluate(val_dir, 'item', run_dir=val_dir, run_id=rid); the existing _check_quality_gate(val_dir, rid) then reads the run-scoped record. Fail-closed preserved: a failing gate yields status 'fail' -> run FAIL.
verification: Objective achieved: FEATURE_PR validation never runs the repo quality gate in the validation worktree -> framework-repo PRs BLOCK with quality_gate unknown
risks: running the gate adds ~30-60s to each FEATURE_PR run (acceptable: truth over speed)
wired_audit advisories must stay non-fatal (they already are)

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend existing components/APIs: core/code_quality_gate.py, core/merge_gate.py, core/model_gate.py, core/pr_gate.py
